'''Scimitar Flight''' was a subsection of the [[77th Air Wing]]'s [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] in the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]], Scimitar Flight was led by [[Kaal (individual)|Kaal]], and co-winged by two other pilots by the time of the initial attempt at infiltrating the shaft leading to the [[Citadel of Axes]]' shields' [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]]. The entire Flight was destroyed by a colony of [[Unidentified tentacle creature (Kelrodo-Ai)|creatures]] inhabiting the targeted shaft, resulting in the surviving members of Sword Squadron retreating.
